players.product: memory (DRAM / NAND) and display-driver assembly & test

quarterly_data.signal: ChipMOS June 2026 unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$2,538.4 million (US$79.7 million), up 6.5% from May 2026 and up 37.2% from June 2025 (NT$1,849.7 million) - the company's record highest monthly revenue since 2014. The company said it continues to benefit from ongoing revenue strength led by a persistent AI-related demand/supply imbalance, and that new capacity from its footprint expansion is being used to meet existing customer forecasts and long-term supply agreements as supply remains structurally tight and demand is accelerating.
